notes: Fixed: the strip height did nothing over the bottom half of its slider. The maker offers 134 to 420 pixels because that range was measured, but the panel was enforcing a separate floor of 240 left over from an older design - so every…
A saved layout now has Open and Use spelled out as buttons, instead of a row of single characters, and the list says which layout is on screen right now.
The layout maker opens on the layout your desktop is actually showing, so getting back to what you saved takes no clicks at all.
The layer controls are rebuilt with the Control Panel’s own switches, sliders and color wells, one control to a line, so they look like the rest of the app instead of improvised.
